title: Setup-Heavy Lemon Soufflé

setup.action: Chill the perfectly clean mixing bowl and balloon whisk
setup.produces: chilled perfectly clean mixing bowl and balloon whisk

setup.action: Clear the oven approach so filled ramekins can move without delay or obstruction
Arrange a folded towel, ladle, offset spatula, and timer beside the oven

setup.action: Preheat the oven with an empty heavy baking sheet on the center rack
setup.produces: preheated oven with an empty heavy baking sheet on the center rack

setup.action: Brush six ramekins upward with butter, then coat every interior with sugar
